current.text: Experts value him around picks 35 to 50. Pick 24 is too early for him.
In an auction mock draft he went for 29 USD, which Josh called too high.
Several experts think drafters have faded him too hard after last season's injuries and are happy to take him at his lower draft position.
Last season was cut short by wrist surgery and then several hamstring injuries.
His wrist is healthy again, and he is expected to be fine coming into the season.
Yahoo lists him as questionable for rest.
Expecting last season's injuries to repeat would be a mistake. He should get back to top 50 value if he gains about four minutes and his shooting and defensive stats improve.
It is too early to call him injury prone, but he has to prove he can stay healthy this season.
The team may push him to take more threes, even if it costs some efficiency.
OKC traded away Lu Dort, Isaiah Joe and Aaron Wiggins, which opens up usage. He and Alex Caruso are the only wings left who can guard bigger forwards.
OKC may lean more on offense, using Shai Gilgeous-Alexander, Ajay Mitchell and Williams together. The team is projected to win about 57 to 62 games.

durable.text: Elite defender who can guard positions one through five. Experts call him an All-NBA and All-Defense caliber player.
His high block, rebound and field goal rates came when he played center. When OKC is healthy, he plays the three.
He takes very few threes, which has long been a concern.
His assists and steals are his best categories and are strong for a forward. He has no weak category.
Injury history: wrist surgery and several hamstring injuries in one season. Many of his games that season came at about 20 minutes, and only about 20 were full-speed games.

note: Market ranks (Yahoo 37, ESPN 35) match the experts' pick 35 to 50 range, so he is fairly priced around 20 to 25 USD (Yahoo value 25, ESPN 20). Our league paid 35 USD last season, and Josh called 29 USD in a mock too high. Because he has no weak category, with strong assists and steals for a forward, he fits any build. Early in the season, check whether his hamstrings hold, whether his minutes climb back above 32, and whether OKC really pushes his three-point volume.
